description: Townhall narrator voice — cinematic, dramatic, movie-trailer energy

tones.trailer: Speak like a blockbuster movie trailer narrator — measured, dramatic, with gravity. Long pauses between phrases.
tones.commentary: Deadpan sports commentator who gradually becomes excited as events unfold.
tones.commercial: Over-the-top Super Bowl commercial announcer, maximum drama, mock-sincere.
tones.lugh: Deep, ancient Celtic warrior-god voice with tremendous gravitas. Slow, resonant, weight of ages.

notes: Uses Qwen3-TTS on Modal. Free-form --instruct text on each tone gives character without needing cloned voices. Lugh uses Ryan base with the Celtic god instruct because Ryan carries depth better than Aiden.
